description: Libram of Discovery Item Level 5 Binds when picked up Unique Relic Libram Classes: Paladin Requires Level 5 Engrave your cloak with the Soul Siphon rune: Increases Health drained, damage done, or Mana drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Drain Mana spells by 20%. "Achieve a state of Inspiration by slaying 5 foes, then use to learn a new ability." Added in Season of Discovery. May not be in WoW: Forever.
